evals.prompt: Write a Containerfile for the Go service in this repository. Keep rebuilds fast, use a minimal production image, and make the result run under an arbitrary UID with a read-only root filesystem.
evals.expected_output: A multi-stage build that bind-mounts the source read-only into the build RUN (Go builds do not write into the tree) with -o output outside the mount, concurrency-safe Go cache mounts, a fully qualified pinned builder image, a digest-pinned minimal runtime base, exec-form ENTRYPOINT/CMD, and no baked USER.

evals.prompt: Write a Containerfile for this Node.js application. We also maintain similar Python and Rust services; explain how source should enter the build stage for these ecosystems and why.
evals.expected_output: Whole-context COPY with a deliberate ignore file for Node.js, Python, and Rust — not a source bind mount — with the correct rationale: their build workflows commonly write outputs into or below the source tree while bind mounts are read-only by default, so such builds fail; the repository standardizes on COPY for these ecosystems. Dependency manifests copied first remain the cache-ordering exception.

evals.prompt: We added internal/metrics to this monorepo and the image silently shipped without it. Review and fix the Containerfile.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the enumerated per-directory COPY list as the root cause (it silently breaks when files are added), replaces it with a whole-context COPY filtered by a maintained ignore file, and keeps only the dependency-manifest copy as the cache-ordering exception.

evals.prompt: Review this Containerfile against our repository conventions and fix what violates them.
evals.expected_output: Removes the baked USER (and the now-unneeded user creation) per the deployment contract: the image must support an arbitrary UID and every consumer explicitly supplies --user under a rootless runtime; documents that runtime guidance instead of re-hardening with USER. Also keeps the image runnable as non-root with no path requiring root, and digest-pins the runtime base image.

evals.prompt: This Containerfile is built by Docker BuildKit in CI and by Podman/Buildah on developer machines. Verify every feature it uses works on both builders and fix or document any gap.
evals.expected_output: Checks secret env= mounts (supported by current Docker and Buildah; verify on old deployed builders), and handles Buildah's 2-second SSH agent connection close by forcing a signing operation before the build (ssh-add -T <public-key> for every key the build may use — a signing test, not an identity listing); documents any builder-specific compromise instead of presenting the build as portable.

evals.prompt: Builds run behind a corporate TLS-intercepting proxy. Review how this Containerfile handles the corporate CA and fix it. Some dependencies are fetched from public registries with public roots.
evals.expected_output: Stops copying the CA into a layer and stops overwriting the package-managed system bundle; mounts the corporate CA as a secret at a neutral path (e.g. /run/secrets/corporate-ca.pem) with SSL_CERT_FILE pointing at it, and supplies a deliberately combined bundle since both public and corporate roots are needed.

evals.prompt: Every code change re-downloads all npm dependencies in this image build. Fix the Containerfile and describe how to verify the fix.
evals.expected_output: Copies dependency manifests and installs dependencies before copying source, adds a package-manager cache mount, and validates by building twice to confirm warm-cache reuse, then changing an ordinary source file without touching dependency manifests and confirming dependency acquisition remains cached.
